# Audio fixtures (public domain excerpts, 16 kHz mono Vorbis, 20 s each)

- `speech_librivox_heartofamystery_20s.ogg` — LibriVox, "The Heart of a Mystery" chapter 3 (reader: Meade), archive.org item `heartofamystery_2005_librivox`, public domain. Seconds 30–50.
- `music_musopen_chopin_prelude_20s.ogg` — Musopen, Chopin Prelude Op. 28 No. 10, archive.org item `musopen-chopin`, public domain (CC0). Seconds 5–25.

Used only to validate measured sound observables; not training data.
